title: Depth of the hypoxic boundary on the slope
query: Using the supplied CMEMS biogeochemical reanalysis monthly oxygen, nitrate and chlorophyll for 1993-2020 off California and Oregon (30-48 N, 130-116 W), determine how the depth of the hypoxic boundary (oxygen of about 60 umol/kg) on the continental slope varies by season, latitude and year, and what controls that variability.
